name: new_lead
description: Someone who is not yet a customer and wants to buy from us: asks about our pricing, a demo, a trial, or whether our product fits their needs.

name: customer_support
description: An existing customer needs help: something is broken, a how-to question, or a data, access or integration problem.

name: billing
description: An existing customer writes about their invoices, payments, refunds, card problems, plan changes or seat counts with us.

name: partner_vendor
description: Someone who wants to sell to us or work with us: vendors and their promotions, agencies, integration partners, resellers, recruiters. An offer of a quote or discount to us belongs here.

name: not_crm
description: Anything that fits none of the four categories above: newsletters, spam and scams, personal or internal chat, automated system notices.
